statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I48.0
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is required
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended period
The service is to capture arrhythmic episodes and guide further management
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
